LanguageData.MF_GalleryRevision_TextHint: Change the title and caption of the version on screen. For an edited version, change its title and note.
LanguageData.MF_GalleryRevision_EditHint: Choose crop and filters, icons inside the photo, or stickers in the paper margin. The original photo file is kept.
LanguageData.MF_GalleryRevision_ReshootHint: Photograph the original location and frame as they look now, without calling anyone over. The shot is taken while you are viewing that map.
LanguageData.MF_GalleryRevision_ReunionHint: Review the people in the original photo, call the selected colonists to the same spot, and photograph them after they gather. The original frame is kept.
LanguageData.MF_GalleryRevision_ReunionUnavailable: Gathering again needs the original map, frame, and records of the colonists in the photo. Animal photos are not eligible for this gathering.
LanguageData.MF_GalleryRevision_CompareHint: View an earlier birthday of the same person or an earlier photo with the same location and frame side by side. This does not take a new photo.
LanguageData.MF_GalleryRevision_CompareUnavailable: No earlier birthday or photo with the same location and frame is available yet.
LanguageData.MF_GalleryRevision_IntegrationsHint: Choose an installed integration. Open RimGram local posting or RimTalk recollection here. Opening this menu does not publish anything or call AI.
